articles.title: Crocodiles Usually Find Their Way Home — But These Ones Didn't
articles.summary: Scientists tracked five crocodiles in Bangladesh. Three were raised in captivity and didn't try to go home. A wild crocodile named Jongra swam 30 kilometers in one day trying to get back!

articles.title: Star Wars Is Coming to IMAX for the First Time Ever!
articles.summary: The original Star Wars movie is turning 50 in 2027. To celebrate, Disney is bringing it to IMAX screens for the first time. A new Star Wars film with Ryan Gosling also comes out that year.

articles.title: Chemistry Textbooks Have Been Wrong for Almost 100 Years!
articles.summary: Scientists say a basic chemistry idea has been taught wrong for nearly a century. Textbooks say atom influence travels through 3-4 bonds. New research shows it stops after just one bond.
